# Maple Ridge Landscaping

Source: https://maple-ridge-landscaping.example/
Scraped: 2026-10-20

=== PAGE https://maple-ridge-landscaping.example/

Maple Ridge Landscaping is a family-run landscaping company serving Ottawa, Kanata and Orleans since 2009.

## Services

- Interlock patios, walkways and driveways
- Retaining walls in natural stone and armour stone
- Sod installation and garden beds
- Spring and fall cleanups
- Snow removal for residential driveways (November to April)

We offer a 5-year workmanship warranty on all hardscaping projects.
Our crews are fully insured and WSIB-covered.

=== PAGE https://maple-ridge-landscaping.example/about

We work Monday to Saturday, 7 am to 6 pm. Estimates are done on site.
